s: once, one time (one and only one time)
Ich werde das nur einmal sagen.
I'm only going to say it once.
Literally "Once is never." (Doing something one time is meaningless)
once (formerly; during some period in the past)
Es war einmal eine schöne Prinzessin.
There was once a beautiful princess.
sometime (at an indefinite but stated time in the past or future)
first of all, for starters, firstly (as an initial point; before any other considerations)
I'll have (one order of) fries, please.
einmal.et: From Middle High German einmāle, equivalent to ein + -mal. Compare Middle Low German ênmâl.

s: Once doesn’t count; one swallow does not a summer make
Mein Mann macht wirklich Fortschritte: Letztens hat er von selber den Abwasch gemacht! — Pah... Einmal ist keinmal.
My husband is really making some progress. A while ago, he decided all by himself to do the dishes! — Pfft... One time. Big deal!
One slip is allowed; everyone deserves a second chance
Solches Verhalten werden wir an dieser Schule nicht dulden! Aber... ich sage mal: Einmal ist keinmal.
We will not tolerate such behaviour at this school! But... let me say: As long as it doesn’t happen again, we’ll forget about it.
One time won’t hurt; just try it
Die Sarah will mit mir zu so’ner nervigen Autorenlesung. — Tu’s halt ihr zuliebe. Einmal ist keinmal.
Sarah wants me to go to this annoying book reading with her. — Well, so do it for her sake. This one time won’t be so bad.

einmalig.et: From einmal + -ig. Cognate with Dutch eenmalig.

Maybe I can try it again.

Zwar gebe es Differenzen, doch sei es kaum einmal zu Streit gekommen.

不过，让我们再回到政治人物的类型上来。

然后老山羊飞快地把它缝好，狼什么都没察觉，连动都没动一下。
